newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers steady in slow end to week.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady in slow end to week.

text.p: European bunker prices were broadly stable on Friday with demand low to moderate in most ports, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were still quoted at around $94/$95 fob, with barges trading at $93 ex-wharf.
Total ARA demand was fairly low, at no more than 10,000 tonnes by most estimates.
Hamburg fuel oil prices gained $1 a tonne as tightness of prompt supply persisted. Demand was low.
Mediterranean bunkers were stable and demand was thin to normal in most areas.
